items.title: Stock market holiday: BSE, NSE closed today for Gandhi Jayanti
items.description: Both the BSE and NSE will see no trading activity for three consecutive days in October, from Friday, Oct. 2, through Sunday, Oct. 4.

items.title: Indian banks faced $500 million FX losses after RBI position curbs
items.description: Crisil Coalition Greenwich said banks recovered around $400 million after market spreads widened and positions were normalised following the RBI directive

items.title: Asian shares tumble after wild swings in bonds, FX before US jobs data
items.description: Bond markets were again the centre of volatility overnight, ​with the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yields hitting the highest since 2002 at 5.34% after capping the ​biggest quarterly rise in 32 years
